commitments.text:
1. Elkview must cause the Project to be designed, located, constructed, operated and abandoned, through 
reclamation, in accordance with the documents listed in Schedule A to this Certificate.

4. Elkview must, in the reasonable opinion of the Minister, have substantially started the Project within 
five years of the date of issuance of this Certificate.

6. Elkview must submit to the Executive Director reports: 
a) prepared for the Industrial Environmental Protection Officer, Environmental Protection, 
and the Habitat Protection Biologist, Fish and Wildlife, Ministry of Environment, Lands 
and Parks, Cranbrook, on the results of the environmental management monitoring plans, 
pertaining to wildlife and water quality, as committed to by Elkview, in the documents 
listed in Schedule A, within one month of delivery of the reports to those officers; and
b) of the effectiveness of the wildlife mitigation plans, including the roll-out berm plan, 
and the water quality plans, as committed to in the documents listed in Schedule A, to the 
satisfaction of the Executive Director, within three months of delivery of the monitoring 
reports referred to above in Condition 6(a);
